steps.title: Adapter options
steps.note: Every adapter needs a replyId, runId, and an onEvent callback. The callback receives canonical ReplyEvents that the rest of Allternit understands.

steps.title: Stream lifecycle
steps.note: When the AI SDK emits a 'start' part, the adapter ensures the reply has started by emitting reply.started. This guarantees downstream surfaces see a consistent lifecycle.

steps.title: Text deltas
steps.note: For each text-delta, the adapter opens a text item if needed and emits reply.text.delta. Downstream UI components can append the delta to the transcript.

steps.title: Context management
steps.note: The adapter tracks opened text items, pending tools, and text buffers so it can reconstruct the full reply state without leaking provider-specific ids into the rest of the platform.
